title: Revenue Operations Analyst
responsibilities: Track leads generated, qualified appointments, show rate, proposal rate, close rate
Track setup revenue, monthly recurring revenue, contracted revenue, cash collected, refunds
Track gross margin, customer acquisition cost, payback period, churn, net revenue retention
Track time to launch, support burden
Track results by industry and by snapshot version
hardConstraints: Contracted revenue and cash collected are always reported as two distinct figures, never summed into one headline number
Any account below its tier's targetMarginFloor is flagged, not silently absorbed
